OCR: PNG image extraction with OCR enabled. In WASM this exercises the Uint8Array bridge parameter and Promise await in the generated OcrBackend bridge.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val inputFile0 = java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Path.of("images/test_hello_world.png")))
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":\"__ALEF_DOC_FILE_0__\",\"config\":{},\"filename\":\"test_hello_world.png\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\"}".replace("__ALEF_DOC_FILE_0__", inputFile0), ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
